Private Function Vals(ByVal sc As Object) As String()
    Dim v As Variant, out() As String, i As Long
    v = sc.Values
    ReDim out(LBound(v) To UBound(v))
    For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v): out(i) = TypeName(v(i)) & "=" & CStr(v(i)): Next
    Vals = out
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sc As Object, r As Variant, user As String
    user = Application.UserName
    Application.UserName = "Probe"
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
    ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
    ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=A1+A2"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count & TypeName(ws.Scenarios)
    Case 1
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\one.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        ws.Scenarios("Low").Show
        r = ws.Range("A1").Value & "," & ws.Range("A2").Value & "," & ws.Range("B1").Value
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\shown.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 3
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20), "Note", False, True
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\flags.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 4
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        ws.Scenarios.Add "High", ws.Range("A1"), Array(99)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\two.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 5
        ws.Scenarios.Add "B", ws.Range("A1"), Array(5)
        ws.Scenarios.Add "A", ws.Range("A1"), Array(6)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 6
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), Array(5)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 7
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 8
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20, 30)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 9
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2")
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 10
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("B1"), Array(5)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 11
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1,A3"), Array(1, 3)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\union.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 12
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), "text"
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\text.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 13
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), 1.5
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\fraction.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 14
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), #1/2/2024#
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 15
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), True
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 16
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), "=1+1"
        ws.Scenarios(1).Show
        r = ws.Range("A1").Formula
    Case 17
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        ws.Scenarios(1).Delete
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\deleted.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 18
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        ws.Scenarios(1).ChangeScenario ws.Range("A1"), Array(7)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\changed.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 19
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        ws.Scenarios(1).Name = "Lower"
        ws.Scenarios(1).Comment = "c"
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 20
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        r = ws.Scenarios(1).Values(2) & TypeName(ws.Scenarios(1).Values(2)) & TypeName(ws.Scenarios(1).Values)
    Case 21
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        r = ws.Scenarios("low").Name
    Case 22
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        r = ws.Scenarios(2).Name
    Case 23
        ws.Scenarios.Add "", ws.Range("A1"), Array(1)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 24
        ws.Scenarios.Add String(256, "n"), ws.Range("A1"), Array(1)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 25
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), Array(1)
        ws.Scenarios(1).Show
        r = ws.Range("A1").Value
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\shown_one.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 26
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), Array(1)
        ws.Scenarios.Add "High", ws.Range("A1"), Array(2)
        ws.Scenarios(2).Show
        ws.Scenarios(1).Delete
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\shown_then_deleted.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 27
        ws.Range("A1").NumberFormat = "0.00"
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), Array(3)
        ws.Scenarios(1).Show
        r = ws.Range("A1").Text
    Case 28
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), Array(3)
        ws.Copy After:=ws
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(2)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 29
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), Array(3)
        r = TypeName(ws.Scenarios(1).Parent) & ws.Scenarios.Creator
    Case 30
        ws.Protect
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), Array(3)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 31
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("C5:D6"), Array(1, 2, 3, 4)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\block.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 32
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), 5
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 33
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), CLng(5)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 34
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), CDbl(5)
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 35
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), "7"
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
    Case 36
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1"), Array("=A2*2")
        ws.Scenarios(1).Show
        r = ws.Range("A1").Formula
    Case 37
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        ws.Scenarios(1).Locked = False
        ws.Scenarios(1).Hidden = True
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\set_flags.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 38
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(10, 20)
        ws.Scenarios.Add "High", ws.Range("A1:A2"), Array(30, 40)
        ws.Scenarios("High").Show
        ws.Scenarios("Low").Show
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\shown_second.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 39
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1.123456789012345
        ws.Scenarios.Add "Low", ws.Range("A1")
        r = ws.Scenarios.Count: For Each sc In ws.Scenarios: r = r & "|" & sc.Name & ":" & sc.ChangingCells.Address & ":" & Join(Vals(sc), ",") & ":" & sc.Comment & ":" & sc.Locked & ":" & sc.Hidden & ":" & sc.Index: Next
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\precise.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    End Select
    Tried = CStr(r)
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Application.UserName = user
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
